given: a stock record whose tracking identity was stored only in the combined inventory_code
then: the stock record exposes batch_number and serial_number as its own separately addressable columns
architectural_notes: Infra layer: a schema contract on the stock_records table realized by an Alembic up-migration that adds the nullable batch_number and serial_number columns. Owner module: the Alembic migration (versions/) plus the app/models/ stock aggregate that gains the two fields; the repository (app/repositories) is the only layer that later reads them via the ORM. Cross-cutting concern: schema evolution / data-integrity, owned by the migration + repository, never the boundary. Verified by a real-branch integration test (R4) that applies the migration and asserts both columns are separately addressable.
